newsitem.title: USA: Alabama National units to merge.
newsitem.headline: Alabama National units to merge.

text.p: Alabama National BanCorp said on Thursday two of its subsidiaries were scheduled to merge.
The company said the merger of St. Clair Federal Savings Bank with National Bank of Commerce had received applicable regulatory approvals and is scheduled to close on Oct 17.
St. Clair Federal's locations will become branches of National Bank of Commerce on that date.

St. Clair Federal is based in Pell City and has branches in Moody and Springville, Ala. At June 30, St. Clair Federal had total assets of about $77 million, loans of $61 million, and deposits of $70 million.
National Bank of Commerce has $483 million in assets and operates 13 branches in Jefferson and North Shelby counties.
